answer: Pay sybil-defection bounties. Any identity that proves common control of others (one message signed by both keys) triggers forfeit of the ring's unvested rewards; half goes to the defector, half burns. The bounty is a lantern hung inside every ring: each extra vertex is another hand on the key, another jetty a member can step off. If each member defects with p=5% per epoch, a 20-identity ring leaks with 1-0.95^20 = 64% odds. Failure mode: a solo operator turning himself in nets at most half his own forfeit, a loss; bounties pay out vested, after an on-ledger signature check.
